C1214.title: SIM Swap Fraud Cases Surge 1,055% in 2024
C1214.summary: The Cifas report/page stated that SIM swap fraud cases increased by 1,055% in 2024 compared with the previous year. Attackers typically use social engineering to obtain personal information, impersonate victims to mobile carriers to transfer numbers, intercept SMS verification codes, and take over bank, cryptocurrency, and other accounts. Attribution to Keepnet would require adding its original report source.
